description: Defines the InferenceMode struct which manages thread-local inference mode state, including enabling/disabling inference mode, and handling related dispatch keys and autograd state.

classes.name: InferenceMode
classes.description: A RAII guard that manages enabling or disabling inference mode in a thread-local context, affecting autograd and dispatch key states.

methods.name: InferenceMode(bool enabled = true)
methods.description: Constructor that sets the inference mode state based on the 'enabled' parameter.

methods.name: ~InferenceMode()
methods.description: Destructor that restores the previous autograd and dispatch key states.

methods.name: static bool is_enabled()
methods.description: Checks if inference mode is currently enabled.
